DECISIONS WITH CONSEQUENCES

How this architecture took shape.

20 decisions and proposals, their alternatives, current implementation and acceptance gates. These are project design records, not formal bank approvals.

ADR-0001 · Accepted design; single-node lab implemented

Independent geographic database cells

Use independent CockroachDB stores per physical residency boundary. Move approved application projections between them; do not join the four lab nodes into one cross-border SQL cluster.

ADR-0002 · Accepted design; static catalog plus isolated migration implemented

Legal entity is separate from physical placement

Keep legal entity IDs stable and resolve entity to store through a versioned directory. Owner-qualified party/relationship keys must not encode geography. Track placement versions and writer epochs separately.

ADR-0003 · Accepted and implemented in fixture policies

Deny overrides grants and geographic eligibility

Intersect entity eligibility, country policy, dataset/field restrictions, purpose, consent and entitlement. Explicit exclusions win. Unknown or failed OPA decisions deny the affected operation.

ADR-0004 · Accepted; normalized example implemented

Minimal global party identity and scoped relationship graphs

Treat minimal party identity as a distinct eligible scope. Apply table defaults and party/relationship/holding-key restrictions to the business graph. A global ID does not imply global personal data.

ADR-0005 · Accepted; local harness and independent servicing adapter implemented in synthetic pilot

One local ACID business boundary

Keep each participating business writer and its sovereignty hook/outbox within its existing local transaction. Co-locate modules only where a business invariant requires one local unit of work; estate-wide consolidation is not a prerequisite. Preserve independent services with explicit consistency or saga contracts. Remote copies remain asynchronous.

ADR-0006 · Accepted; SQL polling/journal implemented, CDC/Kafka proposed

Outbox now, regional CDC and durable bus later

Use a transactional outbox in the federation harness and a local transactional change journal in the migration slice. Pilot evolution is regional CockroachDB CDC feeding independently budgeted durable transport such as Kafka after authorized projection.

ADR-0007 · Accepted; local OPA calls implemented, signed distribution proposed

OPA rules with trusted current facts

Use Rego v1 and local OPA decision services. Construct policy input from trusted state. Evaluate source and recipient admission; enforce route, writer and data versions transactionally outside OPA as well.

ADR-0008 · Accepted; SQL audit and OTLP logs container gates passed

Audit evidence and OpenTelemetry are distinct

Keep audit intents in the local business/control transaction and instrument flows with OpenTelemetry. Use bounded metric dimensions and regional telemetry routing; do not export customer payloads into global diagnostics.

ADR-0009 · Accepted target design; executable queue model only

Separate authority, operational and bulk capacity

Reserve authority-guard and operational delivery resources; cap bulk reconciliation/migration separately. Policy activation commits scoped authority plus a cursor rather than enumerating the affected dataset.

ADR-0010 · Accepted analysis method; measured database targets pending

Treat capacity results as models and targets

Keep analytic cardinality/storage, sampled queue simulations, actual OPA component timings and future service SLO targets explicitly separate. Preserve assumptions, seeds, results and validation scripts.

ADR-0011 · Accepted; isolated migration implemented

Source-writable copy followed by fenced cutover

Capture a consistent snapshot and continuous changes, copy bounded batches, reconcile versions/tombstones/closure, then fence the old writer. Persist the new route as ACTIVATING before enabling the new epoch. Cleanup follows separately.

ADR-0012 · Accepted; live-copy cleanup implemented

Separate denial, live purge and retained-storage disposal

Expose authority enforcement, live-copy cleanup and retained-surface disposal as distinct milestones. Keep durable fences after purge and quarantine restores until current policy is applied.

ADR-0013 · Accepted lab scope; production HA explicitly excluded

One node per store and one coordinator for the lab

Run four independent start-single-node CockroachDB containers and one API/coordinator worker. Preserve regional/service interfaces as extension points. Offer an explicit mdm-compact configuration with two independent SG and UK single-node stores. Suspend US, India, migration, the legacy federation worker and telemetry without changing store bindings or deleting volumes. Full remains the default configuration.

ADR-0014 · Accepted and enforced at service entry points

CockroachDB is mandatory for development deployment

Container deployment uses CockroachDB only. Live UI mode is supplied by gateway configuration, not hostname guessing. API/dependency failure must remain visible, with no SQLite or browser-simulation fallback.

ADR-0015 · Accepted; consolidated lab implemented

One portable repository and verified documentation navigation

Consolidate source, fixtures, diagrams, design builders, ADRs, model results, tests and container helpers in one private Git repository. Build a local portal with portable links and verify referenced files/fragments and deployment claims.

ADR-0016 · Accepted; local HTTP gateway implemented

A development gateway with explicit production boundary

Use an Nginx gateway bound to host loopback, serving the lab portal and proxying /api/ to the single harness. Regional authenticated business gateways remain a target deployment design. Display deployment mode prominently across executable UI surfaces. A pilot gateway serves an explicit live-pilot configuration; an authenticated dependency check is required before claiming a connected full or compact pilot. A static MDM preview uses labelled read-only fixtures. Failed or invalid live configuration never enables browser fixtures.

ADR-0017 · Accepted bounded synthetic integration; regional production deployment and distributed authority remain pilot work

Existing business services with governed peer integration and routing

Reuse existing business APIs and models through bounded adapters. Integrate only services reading or mutating governed shared data; cover every writer of that data with a compatible atomic outbox or local transaction hook, versions and mandatory audit. Deploy authenticated regional sovereignty peers alongside participating services. A gateway or adapter consumes trusted versioned placement: writes target current owner authority; reads use an authorised projection with acceptable freshness or a lawful owner path for latest state. Recheck permissions and authority at the handler.

ADR-0018 · Implemented synthetic single-host integration; bank pilot approval remains separate

A base customer MDM with system and experience APIs

Keep business.party as the authoritative party and add owner-qualified source references and idempotent receipts in CockroachDB. Expose distinct authenticated system and experience API contracts. New identities default to owner-only; eligible minimums and relationship sharing use explicit synthetic profiles. Use separate mTLS recipient peers with current source/recipient OPA admission, exact envelope checks, scoped manifests, exact imported field sets and durable receipts. Keep HTTP delivery outside the owner business transaction and coordination lock; coalesce current-state delivery intents by scope/recipient while retaining business audit and fencing later restrictions; preserve the original lab as a separate trusted operator interface. Add a modern customer workspace backed by a bounded owner/source-qualified directory, keyset pagination and the existing system/experience contracts. The directory remains system-only; recipient identities can look up only authorised customer views. Clear previous identity data and fence late responses when credentials change. Show actual returned owner/projection sources, scope versions and trace evidence.

ADR-0019 · Implemented synthetic foundations; regional production gates remain open

Bounded integration foundations before regional production

Use bounded scope snapshots for point reads, admission and relay; release coordination locks before remote policy/peer calls and revalidate current authority, graph content and fields before returning. Retain strict synchronous authority rather than inventing an approved lease. Require a versioned bounded import contract, exact-envelope receipts and monotonic source/destination placement evidence. Add lifecycle-controlled synthetic identities, explicit per-command attribute grants and registered processing-hop checks. Demonstrate an independent servicing-case service with its own CockroachDB schema and local transactional business/version/outbox/transition/audit/receipt adapter, plus a policy-guarded UK case projection. Keep original lab demonstrations and all real-container gates.

ADR-0020 · Accepted for the trusted development lab; production lifecycle automation proposed

Separate cluster operations from environment and business controls

Provide a cluster-first live console with Overview, Nodes, Recovery and Activity, and a separately navigated Environment view. Register targets server-side; allow only health checks and native synthetic canary backup/restore. Persist jobs and management audit atomically in each cluster, with a per-cluster worker independent of the business lock. Interrupted running mutations require inspection instead of automatic replay. The initial adapter shares the trusted loopback API. Add a separate optional host-side terminal registry for logical stores, retained node identities and observability intent. Commit configuration and management receipts atomically outside managed SQL, with revision checks and request UUID replay. Observe baseline SQL/OPA health through the loopback gateway. Physical targets and reconciliation remain unassigned; saved intent cannot activate placement or change infrastructure.
